The '''Abridon system''' was an otherwise unremarkable [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Abridon/Legends|Abridon]]. It was on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was captured by forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; when Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Brenn Tantor]] chose to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], he and a number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] loyal to him freed Skywalker and repatriated him back to the Rebellion.
